notes.title: The cockpit cam patch
notes.content: Now I've decided the game is leading on VR, I've moved the "flat" version camera into the cockpit to be more consistent with VR and player experience / sense of speed similar. Has taken a couple of weeks work to get to something that feels nice and moves with direction / responds to motion etc. Any feedback let me know.

notes.title: The First Patch is the Deepest
notes.content:
Update patch addressing first weeks feedback. Thanks to everyone who played the game. 

- Reduced wind / sea sounds slightly and added ducking to reduce them further when voice is playing. 
- Added a continue system so can carry on from where you left off in the game.
- Added selectable menu in front end so you can actaully select continue (and added exit).
- Found and fixed bug where pod was crazy on german machines (probably other lnguage settings too). Thanks Stefan8000 for help tracking down. 
- Minor flow bugfixes.
